transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this approval meeting to get the formal readout from our Intellectual Property Counsel and our Privacy and Clinical Regulatory Counsel on the joint research agreement with the university partner. As you know, company policy requires both of you to state your relevant findings and required actions for the record before I can approve this agreement. I understand the current draft grants the university an exclusive commercial license to all background technology used in the project and permits publication of project results. We expect to sign after final legal approval next month. Could we start with Intellectual Property Counsel's readout?

transcript.text: I need to state a critical finding for the record. I reviewed the university's master research agreement and the controlling schedule they supplied overnight. I confirmed that background patents U1, U2, and U3 are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use. The final agreement must exclude those three patents from any commercial license granted to the university and must require separate written university consent before any commercial use of those patents. I have not yet incorporated this finding into the current draft or circulated it, as the schedule only came in overnight.

transcript.text: I need to state my findings for the record. Yesterday I held a working session with the product lead and privacy office, where we confirmed the company's non-negotiable clinical-data position: publication containing patient-level data must be prohibited, and de-identification must be required before any permitted external publication of project results. The working-session minutes have not yet been circulated to the deal team. The required action is that the agreement's publication provisions must be revised to explicitly prohibit patient-level data in any publication and to mandate de-identification as a precondition for any permitted external publication. I have not yet incorporated these requirements into the current draft.
